<!-- version: 2.51.0 -->
The calendar gets a filter sheet, and a little more room on a phone. Nothing to do by hand after the update.

The switches for holidays, school holidays, birthdays and the shift overlay have moved out of the calendar header into a sheet behind one button. In the header they had shrunk to unlabelled circles on a phone, and it was hard to tell which one was on. In the sheet each switch carries its name again, and the button shows how many filters are currently active.

The sheet also brings something the calendar never had: you can filter by person. Each household member has a row in their own colour, so you can look at one person's week without anything else in the way. Selecting nobody means everybody, so there is always a way back to the full view.

Every screen in the app gained a little height. The space reserved for the "add to home screen" banner was being held free even when no banner was there - on a phone that was a fifth of the calendar grid.

A few smaller things: on a phone the coloured dots standing for appointments are now clearly visible against the day behind them, a long appointment in the week and day views keeps its title on screen while you scroll past it, and tapping a day to look at it no longer changes which view the calendar opens with next time.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.51.0
